stem.text: Which description of adhesion and cohesion is correct?

A.text: Adhesion refers to the force between the water molecules due to hydrogen bonding. Cohesion refers to the force between water molecules and the xylem vessel walls.

B.text: Adhesion refers to the reduced friction between hydrophobic lignin walls and the water molecules. Cohesion refers to the force between water molecules and the xylem vessel walls.

C.text: Adhesion refers to the reduced friction between hydrophobic lignin walls and the water molecules. Cohesion refers to the force between water molecules due to hydrogen bonding.

D.text: Adhesion refers to the force between the water molecules and the xylem vessel walls. Cohesion refers to the force between water molecules due to hydrogen bonding.
